text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The leg inflammation discovered after her
debut race had improved considerably,
allowing her to resume training.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, daily leg checks, massages,
and icing are indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aches and pains were an everyday occurrence,
and the days of cautious training continued.
choice_data_list: Umm... looks like you're in good shape today!
Umm... looks like you're in good shape today!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Really...!? Thank goodness.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Well then, today will be regular training on the track, correct?
I shall go and prepare.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I felt my form fall apart right around here.
Please take a closer look for me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Slow it down one more notch, for the details...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *gasp*... *wheeze*...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Checking lactic acid levels—
...We can still apply more load. Alright...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's wonderful that no blood draw is required.
It's so lightweight I almost forget it's on my arm...
You've found a truly magnificent device.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
My legs feel hot. Please apply some ice—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There was much that needed to be done.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I attended seminars to learn effective massage techniques.
I researched and tested various braces and reinforcement gear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Organizing data is deceptively time-consuming, and analyzing it on top of that required specialized knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because I had to start learning from scratch, it was a roundabout path.
However, I was steadily able to expand what I could do because of that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To be of help in the distant future,
and to serve as her support right now—
choice_data_list: (I'll become a Trainer worthy of her!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I don't want to be a Trainer who merely repeats 'that's wonderful' anymore."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, after spending countless days desperately pushing myself forward from the regrets of that day...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After having her adapt to a newly calculated form based on Cesario's physical data and motion analysis, we timed her—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Cesario has finally set a new personal record!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
However... this achievement belongs to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's all because you continued to gather and analyze
such an immense amount of data for me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario's hard work has borne fruit.
There is no doubt about it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, if everything I've done up until now
helped contribute to that even a little—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: How could I not be overjoyed! From now on, I want to become an even sturdier pillar of support for Cesario...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After days of racking my brain over what more could be done—an idea suddenly struck me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What if you were able to grasp
even Cesario's inner state of mind?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For instance, if an athlete is actually agitated and overexcited,
knowing that in advance might help prevent injuries.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That understanding will surely prove invaluable when coaching the girls she passes the baton to in the future...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So, you're saying you want to better understand
my inner self—the personal side of me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: No problem. In particular, I can truly appreciate firsthand how an instructor's inner state influences their students.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I was also raised under
great influence from my mother, after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: It's just—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um, in that case,
I'd like to learn more about you too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I expect we'll be working together for a long time,
so I want to be more proactive in getting to know you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True, it wouldn't be fair to keep things hidden on my end while trying to get to know her.
choice_data_list: Okay, let's do that, shall we!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. In that case...
shall we go grab dinner together tonight?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, spending time together is the quickest way
to understand one another, but I have no desire
to intrude upon your private life."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I intended to indirectly analyze her inner self
through communication theory and psychological tests.
When I told her that—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: No, I'm sorry. I was just so touched by your kindness.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry about me.
I believe nothing beats a good conversation, after all.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
For instance...
just now, you respected my privacy and offered a proposal that protects it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It might also be out of consideration,
to keep them from getting too close.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, what that made
me feel about you is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario peered closely at me.
As if trying to touch my heart and feel its shape.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Kindness, and thoughtfulness. Diligence.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Without laying hands upon each other, how do you expect us to understand one another?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Phew, that was delicious...♪
choice_data_list: Why do you like eel so much?
Why do you like eel so much?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um, that's true.
...Hehe, I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "Because it's delicious" is all I can really say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I can't think of any reason of note.
There is an honest side to her that neither hides nor dresses that up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I mull over the casually gathered information in the back of my mind—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, those days began.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I come to watch movies every now and then.
Just like with stage plays, I enjoy comedies."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what kind of movies
do you like?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Phew... I love just closing my eyes like this
and calming my mind—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, please don't fall asleep, okay?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing...!
It's a stingray, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Plus, hehe! Seeing the kids'
excited faces is just so cute.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The book you were looking at on the shelf earlier—
weren't you saying you were curious about the sequel?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Maybe I should try reading it too...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch*...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how does it taste?
Judging by that reaction... is it a hit?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —We talked about everything under the sun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has always performed well under pressure,
with her condition rising as race day approaches.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To build my skills as an instructor,
I am currently serving as an assistant coach at a junior club called Club Illyria.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She looks a lot like her grandmother, has always been an obedient child, and thinks unagi is the ultimate feast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carefully tucking each memory away in my mind,
before I even realized it—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Thank you for the drink.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Even though I left it up to you, I was surprised to see it customized just the way I like it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, that's right, Trainer.
I found a place to sit over there."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Shall we take a short break?
choice_data_list: Thanks, I was just thinking I'd like to sit down for a minute.
Thank you, I was actually just hoping to sit down for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was very close by.
